runEvidence.scope: ScenarioV0 YAML runs only; catalog entries reference reusable devices/tests, and list/show/devices do not execute them
runEvidence.persistence: ScenarioV0 and device logsRecorded=yes refer to rows persisted in the isolated test instance logs/logs.db (not production ~/.elanous/logs.db); eventNames lists persisted category/event pairs only, while debug-spy-only observations do not count.

discovery.limits: sourceModules is a curated runtime index; every src/ux-sim/**/*-world.ts simulation world must be registered, while other runtime modules may be indexed selectively.
